863e0183.text:
To face Frostmaw, you must entice him with the meat of his favorite prey.

Go to the Alterac Mountains in Azeroth and hunt a hulking mountain lion.  Kill it, and then take its carcass to the Growless Cave, a place held sacred by the bestial wendigo.

Place the carcass on the Flame of Uzel and the scent from burning meat will drift from the cave.

And then, in time, Frostmaw will come.
863e0183.title: Kodo Skin Scroll

a8169b64.text:
<A crude rendition of the landscape, with a clear point of interest indicated.>

Mogodun- z kost a-hine
ta golg
gar thon- kha z'ta gor weard-hald

<The map is in too poor of condition to make out any other writing.>
a8169b64.title: Bloody Map

a9ad677d.text:
Find what the Alliance have dug up. We know what lies in these hills. With this, we will bring a worthy tribute to Rend.

Chieftain Nek'rosh
a9ad677d.title: Dragonmaw Dispatch

de103f6c.text: After preparing for many long months, Kel'Thuzad and his Cult of the Damned finally struck the first blow by releasing the plague of undeath upon Lordaeron. Uther and his fellow paladins investigated the infected regions in the hope of finding a way to stop the plague. Despite their efforts, the plague continued to spread and threatened to tear the Alliance apart.
de103f6c.title: The Scourge of Lordaeron

11044|386a9ec7.name: Doctor Martin Felben
11044|386a9ec7.text: Once, it is true, I was human. What might otherwise be a shortcoming works to our advantage, $N, for I know human weaknesses intimately.

12920|d0c90775.name: Doctor Gregory Victor
12920|d0c90775.text: Greetings, $N. I am Doctor Gregory Victor, head trauma surgeon of Horde Trauma.

15126|425e11b4.name: Rutherford Twing
15126|425e11b4.text: I am Rutherford Twing, the main supplier for the Defilers posted here at Arathi Basin.  As you improve your standing with us, I will make available to you a fine selection of goods that you might find useful.  Should you find yourself in need of item repair, I also provide those services.

15350|44b49612.name: Horde Warbringer
15350|44b49612.text: War is upon us, $N.  It's time for every member of the Horde to answer the call and join the fight against the cowardly Alliance.

214954|6cf4abd2.name: Rix Xizzix
214954|6cf4abd2.text:
Welcome to the Xizzix Asset Recovery Service! If you lost it, we probably found it! 

Check my stock to see if we've recovered anything that you might have carelessly discarded and have since decided you just can't live without.

2216|8e0e34da.name: Apothecary Lydon
2216|8e0e34da.text: We are but so close to developing the New Plague that our Dark Lady desires with such fervor.

2393|e26243eb.name: Christoph Jeffcoat
2393|e26243eb.text: Can I show you what I have for sale?

2410|8b3451aa.name: Magus Wordeen Voidglare
2410|8b3451aa.text: My studies take me far from the Under City, but to truly learn one must be near to the source of knowledge.

259118|b3bb7fbb.name: Muln Earthfury
259118|b3bb7fbb.text: I am Muln Earthfury of the Earthen Ring. What brings you before me today?

262558|165bbe08.name: Palah Thunderhoof
262558|165bbe08.text: What has brought you to the Earthen Ring?

264078|adb68b1b.name: Sutara Plainstalker
264078|adb68b1b.text:
It is my honor to handle supply and provisioning for the Earthen Ring. 

My stock is limited at present, but check back with me often and I may have new equipment and supplies available for purchase.

2706|368f0fed.name: Tor'gan
2706|368f0fed.text: Thanks to the Warchief, even here in the ruins of our former prison, some hope remains, and the Horde rises anew.

276171|1e85fa3a.name: Oura Stormspinner
276171|1e85fa3a.text: We shen'dorei have need of additional cloth to replenish our supplies. Any donations you make would be put to good use, and surely raise your esteem with the Windshapers.

2834|279d82d3.name: Myizz Luckycatch
2834|279d82d3.text: Your skill exceeds mine, though  I've heard that Old Man Heming in Booty Bay has copies of "The Bass and You".  That is sure to help you increase your skill.

2851|c5ceacbe.name: Urda
2851|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

3309|2f8d506f.name: Karus
3309|2f8d506f.text: Besides the Grunts outside, my brothers and I fought at the battle of Hyjal. Any who seek to steal from the bank must face us first.

3309|6b36598f.name: Karus
3309|6b36598f.text: I guarantee this bank's security with my own blood, is that good enough for you?

3309|ae78a458.name: Karus
3309|ae78a458.text: Would you rather trust your goods with a goblin?

3310|cc0cf280.name: Doras
3310|cc0cf280.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

3318|2f8d506f.name: Koma
3318|2f8d506f.text: Besides the Grunts outside, my brothers and I fought at the battle of Hyjal. Any who seek to steal from the bank must face us first.

3318|6b36598f.name: Koma
3318|6b36598f.text: I guarantee this bank's security with my own blood, is that good enough for you?

3368|5a0b913d.name: Borstan
3368|5a0b913d.text: I have the finest meats in Orgrimmar.

3399|48c1c064.name: Zamja
3399|48c1c064.text: Wulan in Shadowprey Village can sell you the "Expert Cookbook".  You will need that if you are to better yourself.

3412|d0fc10c2.name: Nogg
3412|d0fc10c2.text: If there were just a few more hours in a day...

4551|d37b59d0.name: Michael Garrett
4551|d37b59d0.text: How may I be of service?

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

6791|60c5da07.name: Innkeeper Wiley
6791|60c5da07.text: Come in, come in. Just don't sit too close to the stove. It hasn't exploded yet today, but just to be safe I think you should sit elsewhere.

7853|967b8e4a.name: Scooty
7853|967b8e4a.text: Hello, $N! I am master engineer, Scooty.

9087|e4fd33dd.name: Bashana Runetotem
9087|e4fd33dd.text: Greetings, noble $c.  This humble servant of the Cenarion Circle wishes blessings and bounties be given unto you and yours.

1065-complete.name: Apothecary Lydon
1065-complete.text:
A note from Zamah?  Her needs must be great to send word from so far.  Let us see what she says...

Ah, splendid!  I know exactly what to do!
1065-complete.title: Journey to Tarren Mill

1065-progress.name: Apothecary Lydon
1065-progress.text: Ah, are you here with my new test subjects?
1065-progress.title: Journey to Tarren Mill

1066-accept.name: Apothecary Lydon
1066-accept.text:
I will create a toxin to bleed the violence from the Venture Company, rendering them weak and docile.  That should fix the Horde's problem in Stonetalon, yes?

But to create the toxin, I will need the blood of innocents, a difficult ingredient to obtain.

Fortunately the Syndicate, a group of human brigands in this area, employ shadow mages... and those mages collect innocent blood for their own, unsavory purposes.

You can find the Syndicate shadow mages in Durnholde Keep to the southeast.
1066-accept.title: Blood of Innocents

1109-accept.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
1109-accept.text:
As you can see, $N, we're up to some very.... interesting experiments at the Royal Apothecary Society.

As the Master here, it is my job to oversee the most ambitious of our alchemical attempts. So much work and so little time!

You look well traveled for a $c. Perhaps you can aid me.

I'm in need of a rare substance. It's foul material; it comes from a rare species of bats only found in the muck-hole known as Razorfen Kraul. Bring to me the guano from the Kraul Bats so we can begin our work...
1109-accept.title: Going, Going, Guano!

1145-complete.name: Belgrom Rockmaul
1145-complete.text: Ah, a note from Korran. He has been a loyal servant for some time now. I was wondering how his duties were going in the Crossroads.
1145-complete.title: The Swarm Grows

1145-progress.name: Belgrom Rockmaul
1145-progress.text:
I envy you, $c. You have the look of someone who's been outside the walls of Orgrimmar for a while.

I myself would travel in the name of the Warchief if Thrall didn't have need of my skills here in the city. But he leads us well, and I trust his judgement--I remain here for as long as he needs me.
1145-progress.title: The Swarm Grows

1146-accept.name: Belgrom Rockmaul
1146-accept.text:
So, Korran has come to a similar conclusion about these insects--they seem to be a larger threat than we assumed.

A few days ago a hunter returned to me from Thousand Needles nearly dead. He was with a raiding party sent to drive a dwarven excavation team out of the Shimmering Flats. During the attack, more of these insects erupted from a cave in the dig site and nearly killed the party.

They were led by Moktar Krin, and they've taken refuge on the border of the Shimmering Flats. Bring him this note.
1146-accept.title: The Swarm Grows

1164-accept.name: Genavie Callow
1164-accept.text:
The harlot! The swine! Kenata still lives; her family healthy and prospering while I suffer. Forsaken indeed!

My family is gone, taken by the plague. Our estate also forfeit; looted and burned during the war. And after all that, her and her lousy children had the audacity to steal the only precious belongings I had left.

I don't care about the things they stole any more. What I want now are their heads!

Kill them for me! Go to the Dabyrie Farmstead in Arathi, northeast of Refuge Point.
1164-accept.title: To Steal From Thieves

189-accept.name: Kebok
189-accept.text:
Damn trolls! They've been killing off our agents in the jungle! I've already lost a good number of my best guards to skirmishes with them. The costs are piling up! How will I explain this to Baron Revilgaz?

Decisive action... Think, Kebok... you weren't assigned to the post you have today for sitting around... I've got it! You... $N, is it? You'll help me, won't you? There's money to be had!

Here's the deal... you bring me the ears of fifteen Bloodscalp Trolls, and I'll compensate you well.
189-accept.title: Bloodscalp Ears

201-accept.name: Krazek
201-accept.text:
I've gotten reports of a group of hunters that have set up camp upriver of the Venture Company mining camp on Lake Nazferiti. Now, normally I wouldn't care, but improbably, I heard that Hemet Nesingwary was one of the hunters there? He's certainly well-connected, if you catch my meaning, and you never can be too safe.

Why don't you go check out the camp, $N, see what they're about?
201-accept.title: Investigate the Camp

2841-complete.name: Nogg
2841-complete.text:
I knew you could do it, $N! Sovik on the other hand, he had his doubts.

<Nogg clears his throat.>

Now that we have the blueprints in our possession, it is only a matter of time before we figure out all of the gnomish innovations that went into the creation of the rig and make them goblin innovations for our new shredder models.
2841-complete.title: Rig Wars

2841-progress.name: Nogg
2841-progress.text: I don't see any blueprints. Did you hide them somewhere on your body or are you just standing around here to irritate me?
2841-progress.title: Rig Wars

2904-complete.name: Scooty
2904-complete.text: I suppose you should be rewarded for bringing Kernobee back to us in one piece, $N. If you go back to Gnomeregan, these might give you the edge you'll need in defeating that good-for-nothing backstabber, Mekgineer Thermaplugg.
2904-complete.title: A Fine Mess

2945-accept.name: Unknown
2945-accept.text:
You have uncovered what appears to be a ring from the corpse of one of the Dark Iron dwarves.  It is difficult to tell what kind of ring it is, however; dirt and hardened residue cake the item completely, making wearing it impossible.  You think you can make out the slight luster of precious metal and maybe even the glint of a gem under the residue.

If you are going to make use of this ring, you are going to need to find something to get the hardened residue off of it.
2945-accept.title: Grime-Encrusted Ring

2945-complete.name: Unknown
2945-complete.text:
You place the ring inside the Sparklematic 5200 and deposit a silver coin into the slot.

Painful grinding noises emanate from the machine as it begins to jerk around violently.  One can only guess what is happening with the ring inside the machine...

The machine suddenly stops, trumpeting its cessation with a simple "Ding!"  The item receptacle opens up to reveal a small box that is neatly wrapped with a red bow.  It would appear that the Sparklematic 5200 also gift wraps!
2945-complete.title: Grime-Encrusted Ring

2945-progress.name: Unknown
2945-progress.text:
The gnomish contraption before you bears a plaque calling it "The Sparklematic 5200".  The gist of the machine, from reading the instructions below the plaque, is to scrub away dirt that an item might have.  The machine has a coin slot, accepting three silver coins to start the process once the item is placed inside it.

It would seem as though the grime-encrusted ring you found earlier is just the thing to try in this machine!
2945-progress.title: Grime-Encrusted Ring

2949-accept.name: Unknown
2949-accept.text:
Opening the box produced by the Sparklematic 5200 reveals a shiny ring!  Donning the ring, you feel magic power surge through your body.

Inside the band is a small but nonetheless discernable imprint of the seal of Orgrimmar.  Engraved letters are next to it, but only the first three stand out even after cleaning: "NOG..."

This may signify either the initials of the previous owner, or perhaps the initials of the ring's crafter.  Keep the ring... or find "NOG" - decisions, decisions...
2949-accept.title: Return of the Ring

2949-complete.name: Nogg
2949-complete.text:
A ring from Gnomeregan?  Let's see... not mine, but interesting.

The Gnomeregan thing - couldn't have happened to a nicer bunch of numbskulls.  For years they're a joke, and now almost overnight they're making better rigs than us?

Dark Iron dwarves had the ring?  That's even more interesting!  You know, maybe the gnomes stole their crazy golem plans and modified them.  Those Dark Irons, they'd definitely want some major payback.  It's certainly worth investigating.

You know, about that ring...
2949-complete.title: Return of the Ring

2949-progress.name: Nogg
2949-progress.text: You'd think that we would find a way on our own to outdo those filthy little gnomes.  I would even wager that they stole that rig from us to begin with!  Bah, those greasy, grimy... erm, yes?  You need something?
2949-progress.title: Return of the Ring

2950-accept.name: Nogg
2950-accept.text:
No, no, no - I'm not all of the sudden saying that the ring is mine.  I normally don't do this, but your information about the Dark Irons was very useful.  I'll improve your ring for you, better than whomever made this simple little thing could have ever done.  Probably some gnome...

If you bring me a bar of silver, a moss agate, and thirty silver coins for my trouble, I'll add a silver and agate lattice to the ring that will strengthen the magic inside of it.  Interested?
2950-accept.title: Nogg's Ring Redo

2950-complete.name: Nogg
2950-complete.text: Here's your ring, better than before.  Thanks again for the information about those Dark Iron dwarves.  This seems like a reasonable lead as to how those gnomes suddenly were struck with goblin-like inspiration.
2950-complete.title: Nogg's Ring Redo

2950-progress.name: Nogg
2950-progress.text: Do you have the materials I need?  I can't improve on this design without everything I asked for.
2950-progress.title: Nogg's Ring Redo

2953-complete.name: Unknown
2953-complete.text:
The Sparklematic 5200 comes to life, lurching to and fro.  Inside, the helpless grime that has encrusted the object placed within it is being pulverized by the machine's gnomish cleaning agent.

The Sparklematic 5200 comes to a halt, heralded by a familiar "ding!"  The item receptacle of the machine spirals open, revealing a neatly wrapped box.
2953-complete.title: More Sparklematic Action

2953-progress.name: Unknown
2953-progress.text: The Sparklematic 5200 is empty, awaiting a grime-encrusted object to clean and three silver coins to start!
2953-progress.title: More Sparklematic Action

4603-complete.name: Unknown
4603-complete.text:
The Sparklematic 5200 comes to life, lurching to and fro.  Inside, the helpless grime that has encrusted the object placed within it is being pulverized by the machine's gnomish cleaning agent.

The Sparklematic 5200 comes to a halt, heralded by a familiar "ding!"  The item receptacle of the machine spirals open, revealing a neatly wrapped box.
4603-complete.title: More Sparklematic Action

4603-progress.name: Unknown
4603-progress.text: The Sparklematic 5200 is empty, awaiting a grime-encrusted object to clean and three silver coins to start!
4603-progress.title: More Sparklematic Action

4604-complete.name: Unknown
4604-complete.text:
The Sparklematic 5200 comes to life, lurching to and fro.  Inside, the helpless grime that has encrusted the object placed within it is being pulverized by the machine's gnomish cleaning agent.

The Sparklematic 5200 comes to a halt, heralded by a familiar "ding!"  The item receptacle of the machine spirals open, revealing a neatly wrapped box.
4604-complete.title: More Sparklematic Action

4604-progress.name: Unknown
4604-progress.text: The Sparklematic 5200 is empty, awaiting a grime-encrusted object to clean and three silver coins to start!
4604-progress.title: More Sparklematic Action

496-accept.name: Apothecary Lydon
496-accept.text:
Ah, another wretched day in Tarren Mill.  All of this clean air puts me in such a foul mood, $N.

The sooner we can plague the humans here, the better.  I've been conducting intense studies on possible killing agents to use in my concoctions but I haven't the time to collect them all.

If you want to make yourself of use, procure the following items for me:  10 Gray Bear Tongues and the very rare and hard to find, Creeper Ichor.  You'll find both bears and creepers just outside of Tarren Mill.
496-accept.title: Elixir of Suffering

501-accept.name: Apothecary Lydon
501-accept.text:
Oh, $N. . .the flowers are blooming in Hillsbrad and the air is so fresh and brisk.  I can't help but to wallow in the misery of it all.  I look out my grimy window and long for the day when our New Plague brings this world the death it deserves.

As much as I would love to sit and brood all day, my duty to the Dark Lady calls.  Help me, would you?  My research leads me to believe I can make the most splendid death-brew with the blood of a Mountain Lion.  Bring some to me and we'll have a little fun.
501-accept.title: Elixir of Pain

509-accept.name: Apothecary Lydon
509-accept.text:
Another day, another elixir to be made. If it were up to me, I'd just let the pathetic humans and Scourge fight it out.  They seem bent on killing each other as is.

Alas, our Dark Lady wants to help speed up the process a tad so why not pass these morbid days by spreading a little death and disease across the land?

Here's the plan, $N: you go out to Nethander Stead, south of Tarren Mill and east of the river and Southshore. Collect for me 6 Mudsnout Blossoms from the field for my next elixir.
509-accept.title: Elixir of Agony

527-accept.name: High Executor Darthalia
527-accept.text:
Stand at attention while addressing me, $c.

I am under direct command of Varimathras.  We are to quell the human infestation until our apothecaries can develop the new plague.

Our information leads us to believe that the town of Hillsbrad is vulnerable to attack.  Your first assignment is aimed at disrupting their food supply and infrastructure.

Travel west.  Raid the northernmost farms of Hillsbrad Fields.  Make sure that the landowners, Farmer Ray and Farmer Getz, are executed as well.
527-accept.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

544-accept.name: Magus Wordeen Voidglare
544-accept.text:
I came to Tarren Mill to research, but now must resolve a crisis. You see, four Forsaken fled the Undercity a few months ago. They turned their backs on their brethren, but what's worse...they stole from the Dark Lady.

These thieves broke into a secure vault and stole four artifacts, items our apothecaries required in certain studies. Sylvanas would have these artifacts returned.

The thieves fled the Undercity to Dalaran, and those wizards quarantined them in the Lordamere Internment Camp.
544-accept.title: Prison Break In

547-accept.name: Deathguard Humbert
547-accept.text:
High Executor Darthalia sent me to keep watch of Dun Garok from a distance.  I had set up camp just out of sight.  But when morning came and I had to boil water, I left to gather firewood.

When I returned to camp, I discovered my gear was missing.

Apparently some dwarven scouts from Dun Garok had passed by and made off with it.  I need my sword!  If you can get it back for me I would be so grateful.  So many dwarves there...it will be quite difficult to find the dirty little thief who stole it.
547-accept.title: Humbert's Sword

552-accept.name: Novice Thaivand
552-accept.text:
Master Helcular was almost complete with his transformation into a Lich when a human lynch mob discovered his ritual lair in the hills and brutally killed him.  To make matters worse they buried his corpse in the Southshore cemetery.

Such disregard for the great wizard is unacceptable.  As his apprentice I shall see to it that the rains of vengeance fall upon the town of Southshore.

We will need Helcular's Rod first.  Yeti overtook his ritual lair.  Undoubtedly one of the beasts has it.
552-accept.title: Helcular's Revenge

556-accept.name: Keeper Bel'varil
556-accept.text:
A notable talent of the wizards of Dalaran is their familiarity with elementals: powerful creatures from other dimensions.  The wizards use magical tokens as a means to control these elementals.  Magus Voidglare would like some of these tokens to study.

Enter the territories of the Dalaran wizards, west of Hillsbrad, and gather the tokens.

You might find the tokens on any citizen of Dalaran, but I suggest hunting at the internment camp.  It's safer than Dalaran itself.
556-accept.title: Stone Tokens

567-accept.name: Unknown
567-accept.text:
Dangerous!

The following humans of Hillsbrad have been deemed dangerous and are marked for bounty by High Executor Darthalia:

Clerk Horrace Whitesteed.  Wanted for the murder of Deathguard Toma.

Citizen Wilkes.  Wanted for the murder of Apothecary Eli.

Miner Hackett.  Wanted for the murder of Deathstalker Fry.

Farmer Kalaba.  Wanted for the ambush of supplies from the Undercity.

All of these enemies are hiding and will be hard to find.  A reward will be granted upon notice of their death.
567-accept.title: Dangerous!

575-accept.name: Drizzlik
575-accept.text:
"The finest leathercrafter of the South Seas and the worlds old and new." That's what they call me. Me! Drizzlik! The finest lea... Ahem. Well.

My leather goods are known far and wide as the most exquisite, a connoisseur's choice!

I've just received an order from Director Riddlevox of the Tinkers' Union for a dozen of his favorite Excelsior-line boots. Our best sellers, actually.

To start on the basic shape, I'll need crocolisk skins from the crocs along the river in northern Stranglethorn.
575-accept.title: Supply and Demand

605-accept.name: Crank Fizzlebub
605-accept.text:
The Singing Crystals are unique to Stranglethorn, and are very valuable to certain parties.  I can move those crystals, but the cursed Venture Company makes it hard for an honest entrepreneur like myself to gather any!

I'd like to hire you.

The basilisks in Stranglethorn eat the crystal.  This gives them their hardened skin, and sometimes decent quality crystal can be harvested from it.

You can get it from any basilisk, but the less nasty ones are along the shores south of Zul'Kunda, to the north.
605-accept.title: Singing Blue Shards

606-accept.name: "Sea Wolf" MacKinley
606-accept.text:
If there's one thing I can't stand, it's people who don't pay their gambling debts!  And there are a lot of people who owe me. Think you can help me collect?

First, there's "Shaky" Phillipe down by the docks.  He owes me plenty after last week's game and I want my due!  But to get it, we'll have to scare him.

Go out of town and hunt Elder Mistvale Gorillas.  Find a nice selection of giblets, then take them to Shaky.  Don't let on that they're from an animal; let him think the worst.
606-accept.title: Scaring Shaky

655-accept.name: Gor'mul
655-accept.text:
It is still clear to me, like yesterday... So many years without hope, with wood and steel to bind me to this terrible place. Then finally, finally! There was the Warchief. Doomhammer in his midnight plate, his warhammer held high.

It was... too terrible... That the blow of a coward would strike down our greatest hero. From behind he charged on his horse, and then his lance ran him through... I fell to my knees. What hope was there? What hope is there...
655-accept.title: Hammerfall

655-complete.name: Tor'gan
655-complete.text:
Ah, Gor'mul you speak of. Yes, from what he says, it seems he has never recovered from the death of Doomhammer.

Gor'mul was a captive here when Thrall and Orgrim fought to free the camp, but as the earth shook and our brethren escaped, he was left behind. He wandered alone and lost for years without direction or hope, until we returned to establish ourselves here in Hammerfall.
655-complete.title: Hammerfall

671-accept.name: Tor'gan
671-accept.text:
I have felt a strangeness in the air... a feeling that simmers in my blood. I had my suspicions. I set off to find the source of my unease and discovered to the west, at Northfold Manor, the residual traces of demonic summoning. As I got close, my blood began to boil and the rage within me grew.

On the ground I spied an amulet of bloodstone, used to assist in demonic summoning. The one I found was depleted, however. I'll need another to examine, but I dare not return to the manor. Can you bring me some?
671-accept.title: Foul Magics

672-accept.name: Tor'gan
672-accept.text:
We tried to settle him in, cheer him up, telling him stories of our mighty city at Orgrimmar in Kalimdor, but nothing would move him.

Tales of our young Warchief, Thrall, who bears the armor and hammer of Orgrim... but, perhaps... Perhaps! A demonstration of our newly found shamanistic magic would give him new hope. It is worth a try!

A small object we could make for him, yes... Bring me some raptor eyes, and I will see what I can do.
672-accept.title: Raising Spirits

676-accept.name: Tallow
676-accept.text:
Weaklings... all of them. You, $c, what are you looking at? Think you're something special, huh? Why not prove it?

The Hammerfall outpost in Arathi's under attack. Unless we send them help soon, their demise is imminent.

But before you go rushing off, you may want to test your skills first. Northeast of Stromgarde in Arathi is an ogre mound inhabited by the Boulderfist tribe. When you can handle the ogres and enforcers there, then report to Drum Fel in Hammerfall.
676-accept.title: The Hammer May Fall

7321-accept.name: Christoph Jeffcoat
7321-accept.text:
Who says that the undead don't know anything about cooking? Take my secret recipe for Turtle Bisque, for example. I've known folks that would come back from the dead just to enjoy a bowl! Heh, heh...

Speaking of which, I haven't been able to make any lately.  I used to head over to Lake Lordamere myself to hunt snapjaws, the nasty things, but I can't pull myself away from my work here.

If you bring me some Turtle Meat from the snapjaws and soothing spices, I'll show you how it's done!
7321-accept.title: Soothing Turtle Bisque

79947-progress.name: Owen Thadd
79947-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
79947-progress.title: Geomancy: The Stone-Cold Truth

96774-accept.name: Mazu'kon
96774-accept.text:
The ancient Gurubashi of Stranglethorn Vale were da masters of dark blood magics. Rumors be they'd use pure truesilver idols to channel that bad bad voodoo.

Ol' Mazu'kon would love to get his hands on one of those idols... for academics ya see. How 'bout you gather some friends and do a bit of smash and grab on that drowned city stickin' out the ocean off the coast of Stranglethorn? Kill the most impressive lookin' priest ya can find in there, and they sure to have what I be lookin' for.
96774-accept.title: Ancient Gurubashi Idol

97539-accept.name: Doctor Gregory Victor
97539-accept.text:
This encampment is being left to rot. The siege damage stands, unrepaired, as if neglect were policy. I won't permit that same decay here. The infirmary answers to me, and I intend to keep it functional.

We are nearly out of supplies. I'm going to need more equipment--enough to keep the workers and guards on their feet.

Under pressure, we can make quite an effective field suture using twisted spider silk.

$C, bring me some from the spiders that stalk these highlands.
97539-accept.title: Silky Sutures
